response.sql: WITH matched_orders AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM riskandmargin rm JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), stats AS (SELECT order_count, AVG(order_count) OVER () as overall_avg FROM matched_orders), above_avg AS (SELECT order_count, overall_avg, order_count - overall_avg as excess FROM stats WHERE order_count > overall_avg) SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
